source_datasets: Europe PMC REST API (open-access abstracts + full-text chunks)

licenses.PubMed: U.S. National Library of Medicine, free access; abstracts are U.S. Government work
licenses.ClinicalTrials.gov: Public domain (U.S. HHS data), no attribution required
licenses.EuropePMC: Records metadata freely available; full-text only for OPEN_ACCESS articles
licenses.guidelines: 教学使用；仅保存书目元数据与公开摘要，不保存版权全文

storage_layout.evidence.jsonl: 主集：题录/摘要 + 试验 + 指南（用于检索召回）
storage_layout.fulltext_chunks.jsonl: 增强层：Europe PMC OA 全文分块（用于生成/验证时按需增强）
storage_layout.evidence.db: SQLite：主集与全文 chunk 同表，record_kind 区分；供检索层查询

source_group_policy: 跨源去重：PubMed 与 Europe PMC 以 PMID 为稳定键；试验以 NCT ID；指南以人工 key
dedup_method: PMID/NCT/guideline-key 唯一键 + title+abstract content_hash 校验
